orchestrationTrigger.notCalibrated: ADES.md 3.3: agents launch agents through Paseo tools or the CLI. The tools need injectIntoAgents true (off by factory); the trigger line and that setting need a real C1 run.

notes: masks: none recorded. Candidate animated elements found in the bundle: the agent working/connecting status dot and spinner in the sidebar, streaming text in the timeline, relative timestamps, the context/usage meter, and the daemon connection pill.
focusClick: null. Paseo binds Cmd+L to 'Focus message input' (message-input-focus-cmd-l-mac) and focuses the composer when a new agent tab opens; the GUI must confirm the probe types without a click.

openProject uses Cmd+O ('Open project', action agent.new). Do NOT use open --args: a second instance with a path opens a second window (dist/main.js second-instance -> desktopWindowOwner.openAdditional), and the echo timer captures one window.
timed.newThread is Cmd+Shift+A ('New agent', workspace.tab.target.agent) and needs an open workspace. Cmd+N is 'New workspace', not a thread. Cmd+O is 'Open project'.
No app sign-in. Claude runs the system `claude` CLI (provider manifest defaultBinary claude) and Codex runs `codex app-server`; both read the account's ~/.claude and ~/.codex. No login files to keep.

Data: PASEO_HOME defaults to ~/.paseo (server/dist/server/server/paseo-home.js) holding config.json, agents/, projects/projects.json, projects/workspaces.json, worktrees/. Electron userData is the default ~/Library/Application Support/Paseo (app.setName('Paseo') before ready), holding desktop-settings.json and the renderer storage. reset moves both.

desktop-settings.json keys: releaseChannel stable, notifications.playSound false, daemon.manageBuiltInDaemon true, daemon.keepRunningAfterQuit false (factory). config.json keys: daemon.relay.enabled false (factory), daemon.mcp.enabled true, daemon.mcp.injectIntoAgents false (factory; the persisted default resolves to false in config.js).

Orchestration: agents can create agents only through the injected Paseo MCP tools (create_agent, create_workspace) or the `paseo` CLI. injectIntoAgents is false by factory and gates those tools (bootstrap.js setPaseoToolsEnabled(config.mcpInjectIntoAgents !== false)). The CLI lives in the bundle and is only linked into ~/.local/bin by an explicit install action (dist/integrations/cli-install), so it is not on PATH by default. C1 therefore needs injectIntoAgents true, which would also add the Paseo tools to every Track B request; the profile keeps the factory value, so orchestrationTrigger is null until the harness can enable it for Track C only. The GUI session should verify the Bypass/Full Access mode labels and whether a lead agent sees Paseo tools.

configure uses the command center (Cmd+K, action command-center.toggle) because Paseo has no keyboard shortcut for the model picker. This is UNVERIFIED: the GUI session must confirm that typing a model slug, 'Bypass' and 'Full Access' highlights the matching command and that Enter applies it to the draft agent; adjust or remove the steps if not.
Mode labels from provider-manifest.js: Claude default 'Auto mode' (id auto), pin 'Bypass' (id bypassPermissions); Codex default 'Auto-review' (id auto-review), pin 'Full Access' (id full-access).

Auto-update cannot be switched off from config: auto-updater.js sets autoUpdater.autoDownload = true and only exposes releaseChannel stable/beta. A self-update between calibration and the night makes the gate stale.
waitDone cwd=worktree assumes the agent workspace is the project directory (local isolation). If the GUI shows a managed worktree under ~/.paseo/worktrees for a new agent, change it to any.

A11 on 0.15.0 (repair 2026-11-06, checked on the screen): the project is one workspace and every agent is a tab, so cmd+1/cmd+2 (Jump to workspace) never moved and the long thread stayed open. shortThread is cmd+alt+1 (Jump to tab, absolute, so a repeat is harmless): tab 1 is the block's first seed thread, replay:seed, whose reply holds 'unchanged'. longThread is Previous tab from tab 1, which wraps to the last tab (the handler is (index+delta+n)%n), and A11 builds its long thread last. Jump to tab stops at 9 and tab count depends on test order, so no index reaches the long thread.

Previous tab's default is Alt+Shift+[ and the native helper has no [ key, so the seed rebinds it to Alt+Cmd+Left: Settings > Shortcuts writes @paseo:keyboard-shortcut-overrides to Local Storage. The seed is Local Storage from a clean launch plus .paseo/server-id, because @paseo:daemon-registry names that server; daemon-keypair.json is not seeded. The rebind changes one key only, and the command center also lists the agent (cmd+k, 'long'), but that route would add its typing to the timed open.
After a turn ends Paseo collapses the tool calls of the long thread to 'Read 1 file' above LONGTHREAD-END, so the reopened thread is short on screen and A11 scroll has little to move.

bench/adapters/paseo.ts holds waitDone for replay:long-2000 until THREAD-END is on screen: the thread paints about 9 steps a second after the session log ended, only while its tab is open, and A11 must not start before the paint ends.
